hook: Random encoders plus expurgation beat the best known distance for 192 qubit codes in Grassl's tables
hook_turn: beat the best known distance for 192 qubit codes in Grassl's tables
summary: The author generates random quantum error-correcting codes, then removes low-weight logical operators by promoting some to stabilizers. 192 codes exceed the listed distance by one or two, and their distances are certified exactly by exhaustive enumeration. A counting argument predicts 619 more improvements. The gains are for specific sizes and the codes are not shown to be practical to decode.
title: Random encoders and expurgation improve 1,873 entries of the Grassl qubit code tables
